name: Optical LED driver
model: Doric programmable LED driver / LEDFLS family
geometryBrief: Controller, LED module, fiber port, heat sink and TTL inputs; exact model revision pending.
behaviorBrief: Pulse sequence, spectral emission and delivered optical power; use calibrated coupling loss.
inputs: TTL event stream, LED module spectrum, current-to-power calibration and coupling factor
outputs: Fiber-output optical power (W) vs time, spectrum and calibration ID
acceptance: Replay a calibrated constant-amplitude square pulse. The integrated delivered energy should equal calibrated output power × pulse duration after the fixture coupling loss.

name: Laser diode module
geometryBrief: Diode module, driver enclosure, fiber coupler, status and interlock controls.
behaviorBrief: Source wavelength and power, divergence and pulse timing; no physical alignment instructions.
inputs: Laser/driver configuration ID, gate events, calibrated spectrum, output power and divergence
outputs: Time-stamped optical-source state, wavelength (m), power (W) and beam envelope
acceptance: Toggle the emission-enable state while gate pulses continue. The disabled interval should contain zero emitted power and the enabled interval should follow the selected reference pulse and spectrum.

name: Optogenetics pulse generator
geometryBrief: Small pulse controller, BNCs and timing display.
behaviorBrief: Event scheduler, pulse train and shared trigger clock.
inputs: Train duration and intervals (s), trigger mode, input edge times and shared clock ID
outputs: Clock-tagged TTL edges, pulse indices and synchronization markers
acceptance: Schedule ten equally spaced pulses after a trigger. Check all twenty transitions against the analytical times to within one scheduler tick, including the final falling edge.

name: Fiber photometry console
model: Doric NC500 + integrated fluorescence mini cube
purpose: Represent fluorescence sensing during neural experiments.
geometryBrief: Console, cube, light paths, photodetector ports and patch cords.
behaviorBrief: Fluorescence model, modulation, background and synchronization; aggregate signal not single-cell localization.
inputs: Excitation schedule, fluorescence field or trace, collection weights, background and detector response
outputs: Aggregate demodulated fluorescence time series, reference channel and event-aligned timestamps
acceptance: Combine two synthetic emitters of known brightness with a constant background. Below saturation the recovered modulation should match their weighted sum and remain invariant when equal-weight emitter IDs are exchanged.
geometryStatus: First pass: metric capped NC500 and iLFMC4-G3 exteriors; nominal envelopes verified
simulationStatus: First pass: detached authored coordinate-card comparison; original sensing acceptance deferred
integrationStatus: First pass: simulator route, editable GLB, passive named XR display action and JSON example

name: Fiber power meter
purpose: Measure delivered optical power at the fiber tip or detector.
geometryBrief: Handheld display, buttons, sensor cable and compatible detector head.
behaviorBrief: Power reading and wavelength correction based on calibration; sensor-specific range.
inputs: Optical power spectrum at the detector, wavelength setting, detector-head responsivity and calibrated range
outputs: Measured power (W), sensor ID, calibration reference and range status
acceptance: Feed two monochromatic standards at different wavelengths and select their matching wavelength settings. Each corrected reading should agree with its standard within the head calibration uncertainty.

name: Optical breadboard and mounts
model: Thorlabs ScienceDesk / optomechanical family (exact part IDs pending)
geometryBrief: Hole grid, posts, bases, clamps, lens tubes, mirrors, stages and mounts.
behaviorBrief: Snap fixtures to mounting grid; beam schematic and collision constraints.
inputs: Breadboard hole lattice (m), mounting footprints, port axes and component transforms
outputs: Placed fixture transforms, optical connection graph and clearance conflicts
acceptance: Snap two reference mounts a known number of pitches apart. Their separation should equal pitch × interval count. Placing both solid bases in the same volume should report a collision.

name: Fiber LED excitation
purpose: Build fiber-coupled excitation at a documented wavelength.
geometryBrief: Fiber LED housing, driver, connectors and patch lead.
behaviorBrief: Spectral distribution and optical power input; exact source configuration as evidence.
inputs: Module spectrum, driver command, fiber properties and measured coupling transfer
outputs: Spectral power distribution and coupled optical power (W) at the fiber output
acceptance: Use a reference spectrum with known integrated power and a near-grey coupling factor. The output spectrum should retain its shape and integrate to source power × transmission.

name: High-speed fluorescence camera
purpose: Detect optical activity in neural preparations.
geometryBrief: Camera body, C-mount, cables, controller and sensor plane.
behaviorBrief: Exposure, sampling, read noise and image formation from model or dataset.
inputs: Photon arrival field, pixel calibration, exposure window, frame clock and camera noise parameters
outputs: Timestamped image frames, pixel size, digital counts, saturation mask and acquisition metadata
acceptance: Render a uniform static field at two exposure durations below saturation. After dark subtraction, the expected mean signal should scale with exposure and the frame timestamps should follow the input clock.

name: Holographic stimulation optics
purpose: Reference platform for advanced patterned optical experiments.
geometryBrief: Laser housing, optical switching, beam expander and enclosed SLM path.
behaviorBrief: Research-only optical field representation; not a claim of single-neuron targeting fidelity.
inputs: Pupil amplitude, synthetic phase mask, wavelength and focal-plane sampling grid
outputs: Predicted relative irradiance map, spatial coordinates and propagation model version
acceptance: Compare a flat pupil phase with a known linear phase ramp on the same aperture. The far-field maximum should shift by the prescribed spatial frequency while integrated energy is conserved on a sufficiently sampled grid.

name: MicroLED optoelectrode station
purpose: Evaluate miniaturized emitters integrated with electrode devices.
geometryBrief: Probe holder, microLED chip, electrical leads, optical sensor and thermal probe.
behaviorBrief: Per-emitter output, optical spread, thermal coupling and opsin response; requires independent validation.
inputs: Emitter coordinates, per-site drive waveform, emission and thermal calibrations, optical tissue and opsin models
outputs: Per-emitter optical power, local irradiance, temperature rise and photocurrent with separate model IDs
acceptance: Switch one emitter on in a symmetric homogeneous synthetic medium. Compare optical and thermal maps at mirrored points, then disable opsin expression and verify that photocurrent vanishes while both physical fields persist.
